hooks.name: AWS Security Review
hooks.description: Advisory security review for AWS infrastructure tasks: IAM least privilege, browser isolation, resource exposure, and cost implications

action.prompt:
⚠️  AWS Infrastructure Task Detected — Security Review Required

Before executing this task, perform a security review on these dimensions:

1️⃣  **IAM Least Privilege**
   - [ ] All policies use explicit Allow (no wildcards in actions)
   - [ ] Resources are scoped to specific ARNs (no Resource: "*")
   - [ ] Conditions are used where appropriate (IP ranges, time windows, etc.)
   - [ ] Service roles have only the minimum required permissions
   - [ ] Cross-account access requires explicit trust relationships
   - [ ] Temporary credentials used where possible (no long-lived API keys)

2️⃣  **Browser Isolation (Front-End Security)**
   - [ ] No direct database access from browser (all queries via API gateway)
   - [ ] All AWS calls routed through backend API with proper auth/auth
   - [ ] Client-side credentials never stored in browser (no hardcoded keys)
   - [ ] Secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager or environment variables (backend only)
   - [ ] Signed URLs used for S3 access instead of public buckets

3️⃣  **Resource Exposure Prevention**
   - [ ] No sensitive data in CloudWatch logs (remove PII, credentials, tokens)
   - [ ] No hardcoded secrets in code, environment variables, or config files
   - [ ] S3 buckets have `block-public-access` enabled
   - [ ] RDS databases not publicly accessible (deploy in private subnet)
   - [ ] Lambda functions run in VPC if accessing private resources
   - [ ] API Gateway uses API keys or OAuth (not open to anonymous)

4️⃣  **Cost & Performance Implications**
   - [ ] Auto-scaling policies documented (min/max instances)
   - [ ] Data transfer costs reviewed (egress charges, cross-region replication)
   - [ ] Compute resource sizing justified (t2.micro vs. larger instances)
   - [ ] Reserved Instances or Savings Plans considered for predictable workloads
   - [ ] Unused resources will be cleaned up (no orphaned instances, snapshots, etc.)

5️⃣  **Compliance & Audit**
   - [ ] CloudTrail logging enabled for all API calls
   - [ ] VPC Flow Logs enabled for network monitoring
   - [ ] Tags applied consistently for cost allocation and compliance
   - [ ] Backup/disaster recovery strategy documented

⛔  **CRITICAL: Do NOT Automatically Deploy Resources**
   - This review is advisory only
   - Do NOT execute terraform apply, cdk deploy, or CloudFormation updates without explicit human approval
   - Flag any security concerns or missing checks before proceeding
   - If any checklist item is not met, stop and request clarification before deploying

📝 Record your findings in task notes. If you identify risks, create a separate security remediation task before deploying.
